verdict.rationale: LiveKit Agents is driven programmatically through documented, pip/npm-installable Python and Node.js SDKs, verified hands-on with `import livekit.agents` working. The docs cover code-level APIs such as tool definitions and `MCPToolset`, an official CLI was confirmed running, and the docs are also served as llms.txt and markdown for agent consumption. missing for 10: an explicit API reference or REST/server API documentation for driving deployments and rooms, and independent hands-on evidence of controlling the product end-to-end via that API.
